QuestInfo.name: Rebel with a Cause
QuestInfo.0: Icarus is looking bored on the rooftops of Kerning City. You should make sure he's not up to trouble.
QuestInfo.1: It seems that, as Icarus grew older, he noticed more and more differences between him and his family. He decided he must be adopted, and struck off on his own as a rebel. You should tell that genius of hair, #bDon Giovanni#k of the #rKerning City Hair Salon#k, about this. He's sure to have a solution!
QuestInfo.2: You went to Don Giovanni at the Kerning City Hair Salon.

0.0: So BORED! You got a moment? Come on, let's play a game!\r\n#L0##bJust go home, kid. Your sister's worried about you.#l\n#k
0.1: Nuh-uh! She's not my sister! I don't look anything like her or my dad at all! And he doesn't even care about me... You know what it means, right? I'm totally adopted!\r\n#L0##bYou think so? Sometimes family members don't look alike.#l\n#k
0.2: I don't know... I want to ask dad myself, but I'm scared, y'know? Maybe you could ask him for me?

yes.0: Thanks. My dad is Don Giovanni in the Kerning City Hair Salon. I just need to know, you know?

no.0: You just gonna ignore a nice kid like me when he really needs help? You're heartless. Real heartless.

1.0: I am Don Giovanni, director of this hair salon! Your hair is in safe hands with me!

yes.0: Icarus sent you? Of course I'm the boy's father! What did that rascal do this time?
